sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Passive Holding of Subsidiary Shares and Corporate Dividends

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Luxembourg–United States Income Tax Treaty (1996, as amended by 2009 Protocol)
Luxembourg–China DTA (1985, as amended by 1994 Protocol)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended (AML/CFT Law); Law of 13 January 2019 establishing the Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE); Law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies, as amended; CSSF Regulation No. 12-02 on AML/CFT, as amended; Grand-Ducal Regulation of 13 January 2010 relating to the application of the AML/CFT Law; EU Directive (EU) 2015/849 as transposed; Regulation (EU) 2015/847 on funds transfers.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Good Standing of the Ultimate Parent Entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent commercial registry of the parent entity's jurisdiction (e.g., UK Companies House, Delaware Division of Corporations)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the parent jurisdiction is a contracting party; consular legalization if non-Hague

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution of the Ultimate Parent Entity authorizing incorporation of the Luxembourg SARL and appointment of directors/managers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors or equivalent corporate body of the parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in the jurisdiction of execution, then Hague Apostille or consular legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Passport Copies and Proof of Residential Address of each Director, Manager, and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national identity authority / utility provider; certification by notary or issuing consulate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or consular legalization upon notarization, as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter and Proof of Funds for the SARL's Share Capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Credit institution in which the parent/UBO holds the contribution account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille/consular legalization only if issuing institution requires; otherwise certified true copy by a notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration Form (Identification of Individual Beneficial Owners) under the Law of 13 January 2019
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Duly authorized representative of the SARL, witnessed by a Luxembourg notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized before a Luxembourg notary; no apostille required for internal statutory purposes

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screenings against the consolidated EU sanctions list, UN Security Council consolidated list, US OFAC SDN list, and Luxembourg Financial Intelligence Unit (CRF) warnings. Enhanced due diligence under Articles 5, 6, and 8 of the AML/CFT Law for all Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), family members, or close associates. Screening must occur prior to the notarial deed execution and be documented with timestamped search records, risk ratings, and AML opinion memos.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) at https://www.lbr.lu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be expressed in Latin characters. Non-Latin script names require a Latin transliteration. The name must not be misleading, contrary to public order or good morals, and must include the legal form suffix 'SARL' or 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée'.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On receipt of a rejection notice from the LBR, the applicant may lodge an administrative appeal with the Luxembourg Minister of Justice within 30 days of notification. The appeal must be filed in French, German, or Luxembourgish, attach the negative certificate and the LBR refusal decision, and state the legal grounds for reversal. If the Minister of Justice does not reverse the rejection, the applicant may bring an action before the Luxembourg administrative court (Tribunal administratif) within three months. Name reservations cannot be extended; a fresh application may be submitted after the lapse of the validity window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office as sole registered office is not permissible for a Luxembourg SARL. The company must have a physical registered office in Luxembourg, which may be provided by a licensed domiciliation agent. The SPV must retain real substance: local directors, local bank account, accounting records, and decision-making infrastructure, otherwise it may be deemed a tax resident elsewhere or treated as an artificial arrangement under substance requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-Medium: approximate 15–25% annual likelihood for a passive equity holding SPV; likelihood rises to 30–40% if the SPV shows insufficient substance indicators (e.g., no local bank account, non-resident managers, all operational decisions taken abroad).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability check and reservation (certificat de non-concurrence) before the Luxembourg Business Registers
Drafting and negotiation of the Articles of Association (statuts) by a Luxembourg avocat/notary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (fixed fee or hourly rate €300–€600/hour)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial incorporation deed execution (authentic act) before a Luxembourg notary
Registration of the SARL with the Luxembourg Registry of Commerce and Companies (RCS)
Publication of the incorporation deed in the Electronic Collection of Companies and Associations (RESA)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Journal officiel du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg / RESA

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of beneficial owners (UBO) with the Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory RBE filing tariff or standard compliance handling

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Domiciliation service (registered office) for the first fiscal year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent in Luxembourg (domiciliation service provider)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for domiciliation package including administrative handling

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization of ultimate parent entity corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: National apostille/legalization authority in the parent's jurisdiction (e.g., Secretary of State, Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee per document and prevailing courier charges

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP/sanctions screening and UBO due diligence package conducted by Luxembourg AML counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg AML-compliance counsel / certified chartered accountant
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Flat fee per UBO per database screening and risk assessment memorandum

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended (Loi du 10 août 1915 concernant les sociétés commerciales), SARL regime at Articles 710-1 et seq.; amended Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies (RCS Law) and rules governing publication in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), operated by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) through the lbr.lu electronic portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Acte de constitution notarié (notarised deed of incorporation), filed by the notary with the RCS, followed by electronic publication in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum share capital EUR 12,000, fully subscribed. For cash subscriptions, at least 20% (EUR 2,400 for a statutory-minimum SARL) must be paid up before notarisation and held in a blocked account at a Luxembourg credit institution; the bank releases the deposit only after RCS registration. In-kind contributions must be fully paid up and supported by a statutory auditor's special report.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that: (1) the subscription of the issued share capital of the Société à Responsabilité Limitée described in the notarial deed of incorporation is ratified and adopted; (2) the registered office is fixed at [Address], Luxembourg; (3) [Name] is appointed manager (gérant) with full powers of ordinary administration and sole signature; (4) the manager is authorized to complete registration with the Luxembourg Register of Commerce and Companies and to arrange publication in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations; and (5) all prior acts performed by the promoters for the formation of the company are ratified and confirmed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage Luxembourg notary and complete KYC/AML onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary in the district of the registered office; Chambre des Notaires du Luxembourg
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the notary to prepare the SARL incorporation file. Provide certified copies of identity documents, residential address proof, professional background and signed source-of-funds declarations for all shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners and the intended gérant. The notary will confirm legality of the object clause and require an official French, German or Luxembourgish name form for all statutory documents.
required_dossiers: Original or certified passport of each shareholder and manager
Proof of residential address dated within three months
Professional CV or background statement for each officer
AML/source-of-funds declaration and bank references
Memorandum describing the pure equity-holding object
Signed engagement letter with the notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary requests additional AML evidence, respond to the due-diligence request within three business days, provide certified translations or bank confirmation, and resubmit the updated KYC pack.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Verify corporate name and reserve availability
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) / Luxembourg Business Registers online name desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed company name, legal-form suffix 'S.à r.l.' and a short object summary to LBR to obtain a negative certificate or written confirmation that the name is not identical or confusingly similar. Reserve the name for use in the notarial deed. The object must be restricted to passive holding of participations to avoid activation of the commercial establishment licensing regime.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name with SARL suffix
Short object/purpose description
Identity details of the incorporating shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, select a new distinctive name, re-submit the name request and update the draft articles before notarisation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open blocked capital account and deposit minimum paid-up capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg credit institution or notary's escrow service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a pre-incorporation bank account in the name 'SARL en formation' with the notary as account signatory, or a dedicated blocked account in the future company's name. Deposit at least EUR 2,400, or the higher amount stated in the articles, and obtain a capital blocking certificate (attestation de blocage de fonds) confirming that the funds are irrevocably blocked until RCS registration.
required_dossiers: Notarially prepared draft articles of association
AML/KYC dossier of all subscribers
Proof of source of funds for the cash contribution
Bank account opening forms for the future SARL
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank questions the UBO structure, provide an updated ownership diagram and current passports; if the bank declines, engage another Luxembourg credit institution and obtain a fresh blocking certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute notarised deed of incorporation and appoint officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appear before the notary personally or by authenticated power of attorney. The deed must contain the articles of association, share subscription, paid-up capital statement, registered office address, gérant appointment and acceptance. The notary verifies the capital blocking certificate and identity of the signatories, then issues authentic copies for RCS filing.
required_dossiers: Draft notarial deed of incorporation
Capital blocking certificate
Original powers of attorney if signing remotely
Valid passport or national ID of all signatories
Acceptance letter from the appointed gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies substantive defects, revise the articles and schedule a new execution date; if remote signing is needed, complete Luxembourg consular or apostille authentication of the power of attorney.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File incorporation deed with RCS and obtain legal personality
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) / Luxembourg Business Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary submits the authenticated deed and supporting RCS forms electronically through LBR. The RCS checks name availability, object, capital statement and statutory formalities. Upon registration, the company receives its RCS registration number, acquires legal personality, and the bank releases the blocked capital.
required_dossiers: Authentic deed of incorporation
Notary's RCS filing form
Bank capital blocking or release certificate
Manager's acceptance letter and specimen signature
Proof of registered office address or domiciliation agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a query or opposition, the notary files a corrective memorandum; simple data corrections are re-filed, while substantive article changes require a subsequent shareholder or manager resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publish in RESA electronic companies gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RCS / Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After RCS registration, the notary submits the publication request so that the deed of incorporation and the articles are published in RESA. This publication gives third parties legal notice of the company's existence and statutory terms. Future amendments and annual accounts will use the same electronic publication channel.
required_dossiers: RCS registration certificate
Notarised deed of incorporation
LBR publication notice form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If RESA publication is suspended, the notary applies for publication rectification by submitting proof of RCS registration and, if applicable, paying the reduced publication fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain tax matricule and confirm establishment-regime status
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT); Centre commun de la sécurité sociale (CCSS) only if employees are hired
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm that RCS registration has automatically created the company's Luxembourg tax matricule in the AEDT e-space. A pure equity-holding SARL does not require VAT registration because it performs no economic activity for VAT purposes and does not require an autorisation d'établissement under the amended Law of 2 September 2011 on access to the professions. Register with CCSS only when staff are engaged; otherwise submit nil declarations where required by the authorities.
required_dossiers: RCS excerpt or registration certificate
Articles of association
Manager's identity document
Registered-office lease or commercial domiciliation agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the matricule is not automatically generated, file AEDT registration form 1-a via MyGuichet; if a bank asks for a VAT number, submit a written explanation to the AEDT confirming the passive holding exemption.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable; the Ministry of Economy's industrial licensing directorate would become competent only if the company's object changes to active commercial, manufacturing or other regulated activity.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — exempt pure equity-holding SPV under ISIC 6420; no autorisation d'établissement required under the amended Law of 2 September 2011 on access to the professions.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no installation classée, no industrial establishment; registered office or commercial domiciliation only.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable. No process wastewater, combustion plant, or VOC-emitting activity is present. If a domiciliation agent is used, the agent's premises must continue to comply with municipal building and environmental safety rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable to a passive equity-holding SPV. The registered office must be a legally occupiable commercial address; the landlord or domiciliation agent must hold their own fire-safety, building-occupancy and structural-load certificates. No employee-related occupational health clearance is required for a manager-only passive holding company; if employees are added later, the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM) requirements will apply.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD, Luxembourg Inland Revenue) for corporate income and municipal business taxes; Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT (TVA). Unified e-government portal: MyGuichet.lu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a newly incorporated SARL: (1) execute notarial deed of incorporation; (2) register with the Luxembourg Business Registers (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés, RCS) through MyGuichet.lu; (3) obtain the statutory national identification number (numéro d'identification national / matricule) and RCS registration number; (4) ACD automatically opens the corporate tax file (numéro de dossier fiscal); (5) apply to AEDT for the Luxembourg VAT identification number (format 'LU' + 8 digits) using form 640/641, generally issued within 2–4 weeks. No separate TIN is required beyond these identifiers; the matricule is used for social, statistical and filing purposes.
statutory_election_mechanisms: Participation exemption (Art. 166 L.I.R.) — 100% exemption for qualifying dividend income and capital gains on qualifying shareholdings (≥10% of share capital or ≥EUR 1.2M acquisition cost; 12-month holding period; anti-abuse substance and look-through conditions).
VAT grouping election (assujetti unique) under Art. 60 of the VAT Law, allowing a single VAT registration for closely-linked Luxembourg entities.
Foreign permanent establishment exemption election (treaty-based or unilateral credit method), with corresponding taxable-base adjustment for exempt PE income.
No US-style check-the-box election exists under Luxembourg law; entity classification is statutory, and a SARL is an opaque, CIT-liable legal person.

Hybrid mismatch alignments under ATAD I/II (interest limitation, hybrid instrument and hybrid entity rules) are reported on the Luxembourg corporate income tax return; no elective hybrid characterization is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée, TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual taxable turnover (small-business exemption, Art. 57(b) VAT Law; threshold does not apply to a holding SPV that recharges management, finance, IT or similar services to affiliates, in which case VAT registration is mandatory regardless of turnover)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory B2G e-invoicing through the PEPPOL network (Law of 2021); no general B2B real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping obligation; B2B e-invoicing (Factur-X, UBL) is voluntary; taxpayers must retain complete invoice archives, electronic fiscal records and customs documentation for the statutory retention period and must make them available to ACD/AEDT upon request during risk-based audits.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to (i) exports of goods physically removed from Luxembourg to a non-EU destination, (ii) intra-Community supplies to an EU VAT-registered customer holding a valid VAT number, and (iii) specified international/re-export services (Art. 43–46 and Art. 58 VAT Law) including transport and services directly linked to exports. A pure equity holding SPV (ISIC 6420) generally supplies no goods; zero-rating is relevant only where the SPV recharges cross-border group services (e.g., financing, management, shareholder services) under B2B place-of-supply rules, or for share sales, which are VAT-exempt rather than zero-rated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / CMR transport document evidencing physical removal
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank transfer proof evidencing export proceeds (where required under AML/FX rules)
Customer's valid EU VAT identification number (for intra-Community supplies)
Delivery/acceptance certificates or warehouse release documents
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEDT/ACD conduct risk-based audits verifying transport documents, counterparty VAT status and economic substance; absence of transport proof disqualifies zero-rating and triggers VAT reassessment at 17%, default interest, fines of EUR 250 to EUR 4,000 per infringement (Art. 67–70 VAT Law), criminal prosecution and imprisonment for fraudulent schemes, joint and several liability of directors, and retrospective clawback under the general anti-abuse rule (Art. 6 Tax Adaptation Law) and EU mutual-assistance / HERCULES fraud prevention procedures.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL) – the Luxembourg branch of the Eurosystem and the national monetary authority. Luxembourg does not maintain a separate foreign-exchange administration; foreign-exchange and capital-movement policy are governed by EU Treaty provisions on free movement of capital and regulated at national level by BCL, the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF), and the Ministry of Finance. BCL is responsible for balance-of-payments reporting statistics collected through resident banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The official currency is the euro (EUR), which is fully convertible in both current and capital account transactions. Luxembourg law and EU law (Articles 63–66 TFEU) prohibit restrictions on capital movements and payments between member states and third countries, subject only to EU sanctions and anti-money-laundering measures. There are no exchange licences, surrender requirements, approval gates or repatriation taxes for equity injection, dividend remission, or disposal proceeds. Withholding tax on outbound dividends to EU/EEA qualifying parents can be reduced to 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive; non-EU shareholders may rely on Luxembourg tax treaties or the domestic 15% withholding tax regime where applicable. In practice, banks independently verify FX transactions for sanctions screening, source of funds, and tax transparency, but no administrative convertibility authorisation is required.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Luxembourg has no statutory requirement to surrender, convert, or repatriate export proceeds. For a pure equity holding SARL (ISIC 6420), the concept of merchandise export proceeds is not relevant; any incidental service income may be retained in EUR or another currency at the entity's choice. All non-resident transactions above Eurostat/BCL reporting thresholds are captured via resident banks for national balance-of-payments statistics; the reporting obligation falls on the bank, not the SPV, and does not impose any conversion ratio or repatriation timeline.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État de Luxembourg (BCEE / Spuerkeess)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (EUR) and Operational Current Account
Escrow / Settlement Account (EUR multicurrency) with segregated ledger capabilities
Corporate Operational Account and Capital Contribution Account
Operational Account (EUR) with sub-account for treasury FX hedging
Multicurrency Corporate Account (EUR/USD/CHF) and Custody-Capable Account
Cash Management Treasury Account (EUR/Non-EUR) with Payment and FX modules

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-medium. Luxembourg recognises authorised Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) and Payment Institutions (PIs) under PSD2 and the CSSF regulatory framework. An EEA-incorporated EMI passporting into Luxembourg may provide payment accounts, SEPA/wire issuance, and corporate cards, but it is not a substitute for a fully licensed credit institution for a pure holding SPV that receives equity capital, holds investor proceeds, or executes intercompany settlements. Non-EEA offshore digital EMI wallets are not viable: they are generally unregulated, cannot access SWIFT MT103 interbank clearing, do not provide deposit protection, and trigger AML/KYC and central-bank reporting gaps. Use a Luxembourg/EEA-licensed EMI only as a secondary disbursement tool for low-value operational payments and never as the principal custody or clearing rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Luxembourg banks are not statutorily obliged to demand a physical meeting in every case, but a physical appearance of at least one authorising director or ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) is the prevailing standard for non-resident owned pure holding SPVs. Many tier-one banks permit video-enabled onboarding where the client already has a banking relationship, or where lawyers/notaries certify the identity documents. However, for a newly established SARL with directors domiciled outside Luxembourg, banks will typically require: (i) original apostilled/legalised articles, (ii) a board resolution opening the account and naming signatories, (iii) current copies of passports and proof of residence, (iv) a UBO organigramme, and (v) completion of a client interview — either physically in Luxembourg, in the bank's foreign office, or by live video conference with a Luxembourg compliance officer. The final decision rests with the bank's AML/KYC committee.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly formed Luxembourg SPV with no trading history, no employees, and letterbox-style substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide group structure chart, business rationale for the Luxembourg holdco, board meeting minutes, signed management/administration agreement with a Luxembourg professional, lease/sublease of a physical office, Luxembourg VAT/tax filings showing ECSL administration, detailed projected dividend/equity cash-flow model, and annual accounts preparation plan.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO or ultimate parent resident in a blacklisted, high-risk, or non-cooperative jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full ownership chain from RCS/Commercial Registry extracts, internationally recognised sanctions and PEP screening results, identification documents for all natural-person UBOs, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements, audited parent financial statements, notarised declarations, and a legal opinion from a Luxembourg law firm addressing the ultimate parent's legitimacy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unverifiable source of initial equity capital or shareholder loan
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements or bank statements of the shareholder, board minutes approving the capital increase/shareholder loan, executed subscription agreement, proof of payment of share capital by bank transfer, CRS and FATCA self-certifications, declaration of no tax evasion, and a specific breakdown of dividend reserves, loan funds, and operational working capital.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-EU resident directors or multiple remote authorised signatories
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original notarised and apostilled power of attorney, board resolution appointing signatories, specimen signature cards, certified passports, proof-of-residence documents, professional references from any existing bank, and appointment of a local Luxembourg ACD or registered agent to maintain effective control and compliance access.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Negative media, PEP status, or involvement in a politically exposed family structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed curriculum vitae of each PEP, independent external sanctions/PEP legal assessment, clear explanation of commercial purpose and source of funds, absence of state conflict-of-interest, written confirmation from the compliance officer, and willingness to accept enhanced monitoring, a lower transaction limit, or escrow-only activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: FATCA/CRS reporting ambiguity due to flow-through ownership across multiple jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed CRS and FATCA self-certification forms, Luxembourg tax identification number (TIN), RCS registration, LEI code and annual confirmation, investor-sector classification under FATCA, consolidated ownership chart showing each controlling intermediary, and a tax-opinion letter confirming that the SPV is not a financial entity or managed investment entity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use SWIFT MT103 (ACH/CHIPS in USD, TARGET2/SEPA for EUR) for inbound equity injections, shareholder loans, or subordinated debt. The remittance message should specify: (i) beneficiary IBAN in Luxembourg (format LUxx + domestic account number), (ii) beneficiary bank BIC, (iii) payment reference 'share capital increase' / 'shareholder loan' / 'equity contribution', and (iv) the shareholder's name and full bank details. Luxembourg resident banks may apply balance-of-payments reporting to the BCL for external transactions, but no prior exchange approval is required. To avoid onboarding delays, the SPV must provide board approval, source-of-funds evidence, CRS/FATCA forms, and signed loan/subscription agreements before the transfer is credited.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For a pure equity holding entity, outbound payments are predominantly dividends, capital distributions, intercompany loan repayments, professional fees, and acquisition payments. Recommended clearing rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 for all non-SEPA and non-EUR payments, (ii) SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT) and SEPA Instant Credit Transfer for EUR payments to EEA counterparties, (iii) SWIFT MT202/MT202 COV for bank-to-bank or correspondent clearing of high-value settlement instructions, (iv) commercial letters of credit under UCP600 where the SPV is financing or guaranteeing trade transactions of subsidiaries, and (v) direct debit/SEPA DD for recurring EU invoices. No restriction applies on using commercial LC or documentary collections, but those instruments are normally relevant only if the holdco intermediates goods trade. All outbound payments should be backed by board minutes, transfer pricing documentation, and tax withholding declarations.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX swap (spot-forward swap in the same currency pair)
Cross-currency swap (CCS/MT305) under ISDA and Luxembourg-law or English-law CSA for long-term subsidiary financing
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) for illiquid or restricted currencies of subsidiary jurisdictions
Vanilla FX options (call/put) and zero-cost collars for dividend or exit proceeds protection
Currency futures through regulated EU/MTF venues, if cash clearing is acceptable to the board

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Accounts Filing (Comptes Annuels / Financial Statements Approval and Deposit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months after the balance-sheet date; for a 31 December financial-year closing, due by 31 July (formal extension may be requested).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Formal notice from RCS followed by commercial court order compelling filing; recurring non-compliance may lead to penalty payments (astreinte) and court-ordered strike-off of the entity from the register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax and Municipal Business Tax Return (Form 2031)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) – Luxembourg Direct Tax Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year entity, the return is generally due by 31 May after the year-end; electronic filing through MyGuichet or the e-filing platform may extend the deadline to 31 December.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing is subject to fixed administrative penalties and monthly late-interest at 0.6% on unpaid tax; persistent default triggers enforced collection (saisie-arrêt) and disqualification of management.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Net Wealth Tax Return (Impôt sur la Fortune / Déclaration IF)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) – Net Wealth Tax Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual net wealth tax is assessed on 1 January; filing deadline aligns with the corporate income tax return, generally 31 May (or 31 December for e-filing) following the tax year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts administrative fines and monthly 0.6% late interest on assessed tax; failure to file may result in restrictive official assessment and forced recovery.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit (réviseur d'entreprises agréé) is required if the SARL exceeds at least two of three statutory thresholds: total balance sheet EUR 4.4 million, net turnover EUR 8.8 million, average workforce 50 employees. A pure equity holding SPV below these thresholds is exempt from statutory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP under the Law of 19 December 2002 on commercial companies and annual accounts; alternatively EU-IFRS as incorporated in Luxembourg law may be applied.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Luxembourg does not impose a calendar-year UBO renewal filing; the UBO declaration (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs) must be made once and promptly updated within one month of any change in beneficial ownership. The corporate secretary should conduct an annual internal UBO data review and file an update if any shareholding or control change has occurred.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $1,400 – $3,800 per year for registered office and corporate secretarial support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $6,000 – $14,500 if statutory audit becomes mandatory; below threshold no certified audit fee is required

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% (Luxembourg City combined rate for taxable profits above EUR 200,000: 17% CIT + 7% solidarity surcharge + 6.75% municipal business tax; 15% CIT applies to the first EUR 200,000)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Pure equity holding SPV can achieve near-zero CIT on holding income through the participation exemption: 100% exemption for qualifying dividends and capital gains (10% participation or acquisition cost >= EUR 1.2 million); IP box allows 80% exemption for net IP income; no special Luxembourg holding regime is required.
